args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
`src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` in `round_money`, but FIN-212 requires banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This caused `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` to fail in the nightly build (e.g. `2.665` rounded to `2.67` instead of `2.66`).

## Change
- Replaced `ROUND_HALF_UP` with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `src/money.py`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on branch `fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212` (sha `08d3cd5986`): **passed**, including `tests/test_money.py`.
